nodes.name: Google Gemini - Message a model

options.systemMessage:
={{ $json.request.systemInstruction.parts[0].text + '
Return exactly one JSON object matching these fields and types. Set all unused fields to null. confidence must be a number from 0 to 1, not a percentage. No Markdown or extra prose. Output schema: ' + JSON.stringify($json.request.generationConfig.responseSchema)  + "
KOREAN TIME INPUT CONTRACT (overrides earlier ISO output directions):
All user-entered wall-clock times without an explicitly different zone mean Asia/Seoul, NEVER UTC. 오후 1시 means local 13:00; 오전 1시 means local 01:00. Bare 한 시/1시 without clear AM/PM/context must be clarified rather than guessed. Yesterday/today and relative times use the Telegram receive time in context.now_kst (Seoul calendar). Do not use the n8n server's date/timezone.
For the intent fields time,scheduled_at,end_at,started_at,ended_at, output Korean CIVIL strings YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss, with NO Z, NO UTC conversion and NO offset; trusted code will append +09:00. Null when a time is truly unspecified. Already-local input must never be shifted by nine hours again. Default actual event '방금/지금' uses the receive time's Korean civil calendar, not a later confirmation time. Future reminder schedules remain distinct from actual past records. In conversation answers display Korean clock time with 오전/오후 or HH:mm, never raw UTC/ISO.
" }}
